    Generate a FREM Model File

    generateFremModel.Rd

    Generates the new NONMEM model code based on the final parameter state, injects the consolidated Full Random Effects Model (FREM) covariate block, and optionally writes the updated model to disk. It features smart comment extraction to preserve parameter labels and enforces positive-definite covariance matrices by replacing structural zeros.

    Usage

    generateFremModel(
  final_df,
  modelState,
  covList,
  addedList,
  covnames,
  strFREMModel,
  strNewFREMData,
  bWriteMod,
  bWriteFIX,
  noBaseThetas,
  numSkipOm,
  numParCov,
  covEpsNum,
  basenames_th,
  basenames_om,
  dDefaultCovValue,
  strUpdateType
)

    Arguments

    final_df

    A data.frame containing the finalized FREM dataset, used to dynamically construct the $INPUT record.

    modelState

    A list containing the model's current parameter state (including theta, omegaMatrix, thetaFix, numTheta, numOmega).

    covList

    A list of lists containing prepared statistical information for new covariates (Name, Mean, Var, Fremtype).

    addedList

    A character vector of new covariate names added during this update step.

    covnames

    A list containing parsed existing covariate names (covNames, polyCatCovs, orgCovNames).

    strFREMModel

    A character string specifying the file path to the base FREM model (.mod) file.

    strNewFREMData

    A character string specifying the file path for the newly generated FREM dataset.

    bWriteMod

    Logical. If TRUE, writes the updated model code to disk with a _new.mod suffix.

    bWriteFIX

    Logical. If TRUE, appends FIX to the $THETA records for fixed parameters.

    noBaseThetas

    Integer. The number of structural (non-FREM) $THETA parameters in the base model.

    numSkipOm

    Integer. The number of independent $OMEGA parameters to skip before the main FREM block.

    numParCov

    Integer. The number of structural parameters exhibiting covariate effects.

    covEpsNum

    Integer. The index of the $SIGMA parameter (epsilon) used for the FREM covariates.

    basenames_th

    A character vector of names for the structural $THETA parameters. If NULL, parsed dynamically from the base model.

    basenames_om

    A character vector of names for the structural $OMEGA parameters. If NULL, parsed dynamically from the base model.

    dDefaultCovValue

    Numeric. The default covariance value (typically 1e-05) used to populate structural zeros, ensuring the $OMEGA block remains positive-definite.

    strUpdateType

    A character string specifying the update mode (e.g., "DataAndModel", "NoData").

    Value

    A character vector containing the lines of the newly generated FREM model file.

    See also

    Other FREM model management Internal: createFREMmodel_phase1(), createMinimalFremModel(), initializeModelParameters(), removeFremCovariates()
